parameter_head_inputs: genotype embedding (4), observed scaled prefix lengths (4), prefix presence masks (4)
initialization: Preserve genotype weights and all core initialization; new prefix/mask columns start at zero.
mask_seed_rule: 20260910 + training seed; unchanged paired masks from the preceding benchmark
candidate_selection: Lowest mean actual 48-h validation RMSE over all three seeds under natural missingness; ties favor smaller lambda_ode.
missingness_protocol: Evaluate both the natural-missingness validation winner and the fixed coefficient 100 under the same three missingness conditions; deduplicate identical coefficients.
test_policy: Train all candidates and transfer runs with train/validation only. Freeze both coefficient variants and all unique checkpoint hashes before test scoring.
scope: Only PhytoODE: remove explicit illumination from encoder and vector field, retain individual prefix r/K head and lambda_K=0, and search the same lambda_ODE grid.
fixed_reference_rationale: The validation-selected coefficient from the completed light-input follow-up; frozen before no-light search.
